name: Patina Extract
description: Extract a seamless tiling texture with PBR material maps (basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness, height) from a source image.

action.description: Extract a seamless tiling texture with PBR material maps (basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness, height) from a source image.
action.name: fal-ai/patina/material/extract

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Expand prompt with an LLM for richer detail. Adds ~0.0025 credits.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion

image_url.description: URL of the image to extract a texture from.
image_url.title: Image Url

num_inference_steps.description: Number of denoising steps for texture generation.
num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps

output_format.description: Output image format for textures and PBR maps.
output_format.title: Output Format

prompt.description: Describe which texture to extract from the image.
prompt.title: Prompt

seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed

strength.description: How much to transform the input image. Only used when image_url is provided.
strength.title: Strength

upscale_factor.description: Upscale factor for predicted PBR maps via SeedVR seamless upscaling. 0 = no upscaling, 2 = 2x resolution, 4 = 4x resolution. The base texture image is not upscaled.
upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor
